</div></div></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-m6h1rj9v2inlineContent-wedge-3"></div></div></div></div><div id="comp-m6h1rj9p1" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-m6h1rj9p1 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px; line-height:1.6em;"><span style="font-size:16px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">You wake up to the sound of palm trees rustling in the breeze and the smell of fresh coffee brewing. There&rsquo;s a coconut waiting for you, cracked open just minutes ago. The sun&rsquo;s rising over the dunes, and your kite is already dancing in the wind.</span></p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px; line-height:1em;"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px; line-height:1.6em;"><span style="font-size:16px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">​​Each day here brings something new&mdash;gliding past wild beaches you&rsquo;ve never seen on a map, sharing laughs with the locals over grilled fish and cold fresh juices, and riding until the sun melts into the horizon.​&nbsp;</span></p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px; line-height:normal;">&nbsp;</p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px; line-height:1.6em;"><span style="font-size:16px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">But it&rsquo;s not just about the kiting or wing foiling. It&rsquo;s about the people you share it with, the feeling of unplugging, and the way we slow things down to really enjoy the moment. One night it&rsquo;s dinner under the stars. Another it&rsquo;s a slow river crossing to a remote fishing village, where we&rsquo;re welcomed like old friends.&nbsp;</span><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.2em; font-size:16px;">&nbsp;</p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.2em; font-size:16px;">This trip is for you if you&#39;re craving more than a vacation. You&#39;re ready for connection, for wind in your hair, salt on your skin, and a rhythm that feels like freedom.</p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.2em; font-size:16px;">&nbsp;</p>

style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">​A simplified, immersive Brazil experience&mdash;same magic, just more grounded</span></span></p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;">Not everyone needs to switch spots every few days to feel the full rush of Brazil&rsquo;s wind and culture. Our Essentials Route is a carefully crafted alternative to our longer expeditions&mdash;ideal for those who prefer fewer transfers, more time to settle in, and a more accessible price point. You&rsquo;ll still get the signature Ventus experience: world-class kiting, vibrant local immersion, and the same commitment to safety, comfort, and community&mdash;just with a slower rhythm.</p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;">You&rsquo;ll stay in <span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">two handpicked kite destinations,</span> each known for their<span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"> perfect wind, uncrowded beaches, and warm</span> <span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">waters</span>&mdash;ideal for learning, progressing, or simply enjoying long sessions in paradise.&nbsp;<span style="font-size:16px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">On this route, we&rsquo;ll stay <span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">3 nights in Cumbuco</span> and <span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">4 nights in Ilha do Guajiru</span>&mdash;two of Brazil&rsquo;s most iconic kitesurfing destinations. Each spot offers the chance to ride perfect flat-water lagoons, with optional downwinders to remote, <span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">secret spots</span> for those craving extra adventure.</span></p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span style="font-size:16px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Just like our other trips, you&#39;ll enjoy:</span></p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.6em; font-size:16px;">This is the trip for riders who want it all&mdash;great sessions, new friendships, a taste of authentic Brazil, and the freedom to flow with the wind.</p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.6em; font-size:16px;">&nbsp;</p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.6em; font-size:16px;"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></p></div><div id="comp-m9jdrwbx" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-m9jdrwbx wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.6em; font-size:16px;">Start in <span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Paracuru </span>&ndash; where the locals ride and the wind always shows up</p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.6em; font-size:16px;">Session in <span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Ta&iacute;ba </span>&ndash; buttery flat water and stunning sunsets</p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.6em; font-size:16px;">Progress in <span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Icara&iacute; </span>&ndash; a laid-back village with smooth wind and chill vibes</p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.6em; font-size:16px;">Glide through <span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Ilha do Guajiru </span>&ndash; a kite &amp; wing paradise with epic flat-water conditions</p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.6em; font-size:16px;">Slow down in <span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Guri&uacute; </span>&ndash; calm waters and a peaceful atmosphere to recharge before the journey ends</p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.6em; font-size:16px;">&nbsp;</p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.6em; font-size:16px;">No stress, no planning&mdash;just show up and ride. We take care of the rest.</p></div><div id="comp-m9jctg8a" class="comp-m9jctg8a cntGx6 L4bhCy ignore-focus wixui-slideshow" role="region" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Slideshow"><button data-testid="prevButton" aria-label="Previous" class="eranmg xhpcWu"><svg></svg></button><button data-testid="nextButton" aria-label="Next" class="eranmg shCNlX"><svg></svg></button><div data-testid="shadowLayer" class="_3HZQOz"></div><div data-testid="slidesWrapper" class="LzcnsT" aria-live="off"><div id="comp-m9jctg8x" class="comp-m9jctg8x vSDtlj"><div id="bgLayers_comp-m9jctg8x" data-hook="bgLayers" data-motion-part="BG_LAYER comp-m9jctg8x" class="QG9w8P axfISv"><div data-testid="colorUnderlay" class="LNYVZi ayCf9D"></div><div id="bgMedia_comp-m9jctg8x" data-motion-part="BG_MEDIA comp-m9jctg8x" class="ROWgFb"></div></div><div class="thDjwm"></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-m9jctg8xinlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-m9jctg8xinlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div id="comp-m9jctg8z1" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-m9jctg8z1 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_0 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:40px; line-height:0.9em;"><span class="color_37 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:40px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:-0.03em;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:helvetica-w01-roman,helvetica-w02-roman,helvetica-lt-w10-roman,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Paracuru</span></span></span></span></p></div><div id="comp-m9jcwk74" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-m9jcwk74 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.88em; font-size:16px;">Paracuru is the local riders&#39; favorite&mdash;known for its consistent wind, laid-back town, and mix of conditions. Bonus: sunset local drink and fresh grilled fish after your session? Yes, please.</p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.88em; font-size:16px;"><span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Vibe:</span> Authentic, breezy beach town</p>

Pick your dates, choose your spots and travel with your own crew.</p></div></div></div></div><div id="comp-m9j5hd80" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-m9j5hd80 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.6em; font-size:16px;">This is for the riders craving more: more distance, more variety, more magic. You&rsquo;ll kite through vast stretches of untouched beach, over river mouths, and across the shifting sands of Len&ccedil;&oacute;is Maranhenses (At&iacute;ns)&mdash;a surreal national park where sand dunes meet crystal lagoons.</p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.6em; font-size:16px;">&nbsp;</p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.6em; font-size:16px;">Each day is a journey. One day you are gliding alongside mangroves in the Delta, spotting wild birds. The next, you&#39;re sipping coconut water in a hammock after an epic session, the sun setting behind your salty, satisfied smile. This isn&rsquo;t just a kite trip&mdash;it&rsquo;s a full-body, full-soul adventure. This is the wild side of Brazil&mdash;remote, raw, and wildly beautiful.</p></div><div id="comp-m9jflb4j" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-m9jflb4j wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.6em; font-size:16px;">Start in <span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Tatajuba </span>&ndash; where time slows down and the dunes shift with the wind</p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.6em; font-size:16px;">Ride in <span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Barra Grande </span>&ndash; a vibrant little town with steady breeze and lagoon glass</p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.6em; font-size:16px;">Drift into <span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Macap&aacute; </span>&ndash; wide open space, warm water, and no one else around</p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.6em; font-size:16px;">Explore the <span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Delta do Parna&iacute;ba </span>&ndash; an open-sea paradise where rivers, dunes, and mangroves collide&mdash;perfect wind, wild beauty, and an unforgettable kitesurfing safari</p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.6em; font-size:16px;">Touch down in <span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Arpoador </span>&ndash; wild coastlines and wind that never lets up</p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.6em; font-size:16px;">Feel the freedom in <span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Len&ccedil;&oacute;is Maranhenses (At&iacute;ns)</span> &ndash; surreal dunes, clear lagoons, and sessions you&rsquo;ll never forget</p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.6em; font-size:16px;">&nbsp;</p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.6em; font-size:16px;">Off the grid, deeply connected&mdash;just show up, and we&rsquo;ll guide you through Brazil&rsquo;s most breathtaking wind playground.</p></div><div id="comp-m9jf7pby" class="comp-m9jf7pby cntGx6 L4bhCy ignore-focus wixui-slideshow" role="region" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Slideshow"><button data-testid="prevButton" aria-label="Previous" class="eranmg xhpcWu"><svg></svg></button><button data-testid="nextButton" aria-label="Next" class="eranmg shCNlX"><svg></svg></button><div data-testid="shadowLayer" class="_3HZQOz"></div><div data-testid="slidesWrapper" class="LzcnsT" aria-live="off"><div id="comp-m9jf7pdf" class="comp-m9jf7pdf vSDtlj"><div id="bgLayers_comp-m9jf7pdf" data-hook="bgLayers" data-motion-part="BG_LAYER comp-m9jf7pdf" class="QG9w8P axfISv"><div data-testid="colorUnderlay" class="LNYVZi ayCf9D"></div><div id="bgMedia_comp-m9jf7pdf" data-motion-part="BG_MEDIA comp-m9jf7pdf" class="ROWgFb"></div></div><div class="thDjwm"></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-m9jf7pdfinlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-m9jf7pdfinlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div id="comp-m9jf7pdj" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-m9jf7pdj wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.875em; font-size:16px;">Off-the-grid and full of charm.
